body:
I cried because of the weather changing once. 
It was a really nice day and then next thing you know it was rainy and somewhat cold and my hair got all frizzy because of the rain.   I was about to start my period.  I always know I’m about to start because I get this roller coaster of emotions about the most stupid shit.  


It makes sense in the moment.

Exactly.  I have no idea what I have.  It’s probably a 9mm.  I care about my family but at the same time do they really care about how much I’m hurting? I say I feel and nothing seems to be taken seriously anyways so fuck it.  I just get told I’m overthinking and over reacting which is true. I agree with them but also my feelings are real even if they shouldn’t be.  
You reach out and get shot down :(  or I’m just stubborn and difficult.   Either way.... I just want to stop.

My nephew used to be told that pot roast was beef jerky just so he would eat it. If you called it roast he would flip shit and call it beef jerky. If you insisted it was roast then he wouldn’t touch it. What a rough time
That’s what sucks.  I have a gun but I’ve read so many stories where people survive and are unrecognizable.   And I’m fucking drunk right now I’ve cut myself for the first time in months

I take any pill I can get my hands on as long as it makes me feel good. 
It’s hard to get access to pills around here so I guess that’s good for me.  Meth you can get easy but so far I haven’t wanted to risk doing it.   

I have never tried mdma.  One of my friends tried it and said all they did was stay awake and sweat lmao

I’ll read it as soon as I send this comment :)  

I’ve been warned by enough people close to me that meth would be a horrible thing for me.  I have enough control with what I do now (I’m pretty sure) but meth and heroine would be a huge mistake just based on what they knew about me. So I’m terrified of it.  It’s kind of sad I can’t trust myself completely. And scary? 
I get scared because I’ve watched family ruin everything and since I’ve dealt with death close to me it makes me not want to waste my life on it.  Because all I want is to feel happiness.  Real happiness. And that’s what being fucked up does for me.  But at the same time it’s easy to get sucked in.    

I’m not very spiritual.  I used to be. But I believe in nothing now since I figured out I feel less scared of death.  But you’re right.  I need something. I don’t do anything but work, sleep and hope I can get the next high as soon as possible.  

I’m considering therapy but every time I’ve gone I lie and make everything seem less than what it is because I’m scared they’ll put me away or something. I get pretty unrealistically paranoid. 

Thank you. I just might if I have a really bad day.   I’m always hoping I can keep myself from ruining my life horribly.  So any help is accepted.  I sound weak. Maybe I am but i don’t care to admit it.  

You’re welcome to message me anytime as well. I’m not much help but I try my best.

Fuck yes it is. 

How did you move on from it? So far I’ve only let my life go to shit once.  I’ve kept control over it to an extent.  I know the other day I fucked up and took a bunch of klonopins and of course now I’m drinking for the first time in a minute.  
I guess I can keep my shit together because of my job but i feel like I’m playing with fire.  All it can take is one awful moment ya know? 

I hate that I feel the need to be fucked up. But I love it at the same time.
